question.text: Portfolio return 17%, risk-free 6%, sigma 5.02%. Sharpe ratio (approx):

explanation.text: The Logic: Sharpe = (17-6)/5.02 = 11/5.02 = 2.1912. The Trap: Other values are incorrect arithmetic. Cross-Exam Context: Workbook example. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Unusually high Sharpe requires scrutiny — might reflect survivorship or data issues.
